other.milling_equipment: Retsch PM 400 high-energy planetary ball mill
other.vial_and_balls: WC-coated vial and 10 mm diameter balls

process_steps.input_state: elemental Al, Cu, Ti powder mixture
process_steps.output_state: predominantly amorphous Al-rich solid solution powder

evidence.quote: A mixture of elemental Al, Cu, and Ti powders ... was subjected to mechanical alloying in a Retsch PM 400 high-energy planetary ball mill with 10:1 ball to pow- der weight ratio using tungsten carbide (WC)-coated vial and balls (10 mm diameter)
The alloy powder milled for 25 h was ﬁrst cold-compacted at a uniaxial pressure of 100 MPa in vacuum (4 × 10−8 MPa) using a manual press.

mechanisms.name: plastic flow of amorphous phase under high-pressure sintering

evidence.quote: It is hereby proposed that sintering under pressure at an elevated temperature (400–450 ◦C) well above that required for recrystallization of pure Al leads to plastic ﬂow of the amorphous phase [18] and causes formation of bridges across the nano- size powder particle-surfaces

mechanisms.name: surface diffusion enhancement by high pressure and temperature

evidence.quote: Surface diffusion is enhanced due to the simultaneous application of high-pressure (8 GPa) and tempera- ture.

mechanisms.name: inhibition of densification by hard intermetallic phases

evidence.quote: The intermetallic phases are much harder than the powder particles with amorphous structure, do not deform under the action of the applied pressure, and also reduce the plasticity of the amorphous phase.

mechanisms.name: void formation by volume contraction on Al5CuTi2 crystallization

evidence.quote: the formation of the Al 5CuTi2 phase with density (3.95 g/cm3) higher than that of the amorphous matrix (3.77 g/cm3) is expected to cause a local volume contraction ... voids are expected to form to relax the accompanying tensile stress.
the samples sintered at 450 ◦C have pre-existing ﬂaws, which are primarily responsible for their brittle behaviour and failure at a lower stress
